name: Xodos (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with a yellow tower masoned black, within an orle formed of a yellow chain.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 6 February 1995 of the conseller d'Administració Pública, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana no. 2454 of 21 February 1995; it is a flag of 2:3, red, with a tower of or masoned sable and open in red, and in orle a chain of or; the tower alludes to the keep of the old medieval castle and the chain is a traditional sign.

features.role: tower masoned black and open in red
